Kia Forte vehicle with UVO eServices includes a complimentary 5-year subscription starting from new vehicle
retail sale/lease date as recorded by the dealer. After your complimentary 5-year UVO eServices subscription
expires, your access to UVO eServices will immediately terminate. Use of UVO eServices is subject to agreement

available from the App Store® or Google Play™ Store. Kia Motors America, Inc. reserves the right to change or

Mazda 5-year/60,000-mile

warnings and instructions. 10. SiriusXM® audio and data services each require a subscription sold separately,
Mercedes 4-year/50,000-mile
or as a package, by Sirius XM Radio Inc. If you decide to continue service after your 3-month All Access trial
subscription, which is included with your newly purchased or leased vehicle, the subscription plan you choose
BMW 4-year/50,000-mile
will automatically renew thereafter and you will be charged according to your chosen payment method at
then-current rates. Fees and taxes apply. To cancel, you must call SiriusXM at 1-866-635-2349. See SiriusXM
Volvo 4-year/50,000-mile
Customer Agreement for complete terms at www.siriusxm.com. All fees and programming subject to change.
Audi 4-year/50,000-mile Traffic information not available in all markets. See siriusxm.com/traffic for details. Sirius, XM, SiriusXM,
and all related marks and logos are trademarks of Sirius XM Radio Inc. Satellite and streaming lineups may vary
slightly. 11. 911 Connect must be enabled on head unit, and activates after airbag deployment. Requires a
compatible smartphone connected via Bluetooth® wireless technology and cellular coverage. Cellular service rates
apply. 12. 24-hour Roadside Assistance is a service plan provided by Kia Motors America, Inc. Limitations apply.
See Kia Warranty and Consumer Information Manual for details. Requires a compatible smartphone connected
via Bluetooth® wireless technology and cellular coverage. Cellular service rates apply. 13. Vehicle Diagnostics is
not a substitute for regularly scheduled maintenance. Vehicle Diagnostics checks powertrain, chassis, and airbag
systems, and requires initial activation. See the UVO Maintenance section or Owner’s Manual for maintenance
schedule. 14. Parking Minder requires cellular coverage, a USB-connected compatible smartphone, and the
UVO eServices app. Cellular service rates apply. 15. My Car Zone requires cellular coverage. Cellular service
rates apply. Information must be manually synced in order to receive alerts. 16. For maximum protection, always
(let us give you a hint) wear your seat belt. No system, no matter how advanced, can compensate for all driver errors, accidents, and/or
injury. 17. Warranties include 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain and 5-year/60,000-mile basic. All warranties
INDUSTRY-LEADING WARRANTY PROGRAM17 and roadside assistance are limited. See retailer for warranty details.
